Dates & sources

The recovered folder identifies Exun 2013, and its HTML is dated 29 November 2013. The original page credits our team at Code Warriors.

I worked with Panini Pandey and Aditya Garg on this design for Exun 2013. We made angular blue illustrations and wrote out the thinking behind the shapes and colors.

I’ve kept the RV and palette artwork here, along with the original page layout. The copy has been edited for this archive.
